header: Three promises we make to every service desk
subheadline: These are not features, they are obligations. All three are written into the service agreement you sign, and the first two carry service credits if we miss them in any calendar month.

items.title: 99.95% uptime, measured monthly
items.description: Measured on the dispatch board and the mobile sync endpoint, published on the status page, and credited against the next invoice when we fall short.

items.title: Your data stays in the EU
items.description: Records live in Frankfurt and Vienna, replicated between the two. We have held ISO 27001 certification since 2023 and name every subprocessor on request.

items.title: A person answers within two hours
items.description: Support runs 07:00 to 19:00 CET on working days, in German and English, staffed by people who have dispatched crews themselves.
